summary: Open Core is healthy enough to keep running: 60 successful analyses, fresh reputation, and Layer 1 still correctly off at collaborative score 10.5. The live GitHub surface is two PRs and a stack of dated bot reports, not missing architecture. PR 243 is the one real change to land by hand. Stop filing another report issue while 242 and 244-246 are still open.

start: Hand-review PR #243 and land it only if the diff is report-footer callsign text.
keep: Fail-on-Grok-error for Grok workflows, and increment complete only on a real ok, never on 429.

actions.title: Land PR 243 footer callsign by hand

If it is footer-only, the operator merges it in the GitHub UI; do not auto-merge.
actions.issueTitle: Review and land PR 243 by hand
actions.issueBody: PR #243 should be merged only if it limits report footers to the CONTROL-01 callsign, consistent with #241. A human lands it; do not auto-merge.
